product_one_liner.value: Mimica helps enterprise transformation teams capture and map employees’ workflows, identify improvement opportunities, and generate AI agents to automate business processes.

pricing_page.notes: No public plans page was found; the site directs pricing questions to its contact/demo form.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in named customer testimonials.

eng_blog.notes: The article index contains product announcements, industry explainers and business guidance, rather than two qualifying engineering posts.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation, help-center or developer-portal link was found in the reviewed navigation/footer; the homepage has an FAQ.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Open Senior/Lead Machine Learning Engineer posting.

model_provider.notes: Named in Mimica’s Forward Deployed Engineer posting for building and shipping agentic automation solutions.

compliance_certs.notes: Mimica publicly claims compliance with both; GDPR is a regulatory compliance claim, not a certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced September 24, 2025; led by Paladin Capital Group.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 24, 2025 Series B falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Open Associate Business Development Representative posting.

launched_6mo.notes: Introduced Mimica Maker on September 30, 2026, turning observed workflows into production-ready AI agents.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No in-window change was found. The small public leadership section lists founders Tuhin Chakraborty (CEO) and Raphael Holca-Lamarre (CTO); it does not provide a comprehensive executive tenure history.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The BDR posting explicitly requires maintaining account, deal-size and pipeline information in Salesforce.
